title: 'So, what do you want to be?' Each type answers
caption:
'So, what do you want to be?' Every student gets asked. Here's how each type answers.

Some bring a five-year plan with salary data. One argues so well against law that everyone decides they should study law. Some just quietly build something.

The useful bit: the better question isn't 'which job?' but 'which problems do you enjoy solving?' Your type is a good place to start, and Career Compass turns it into subjects and careers that fit.

Send this to a student choosing right now, or to the parent helping them.
